basis: Actual visual inspection of all 56 pages in both Poppler and macOS PDFKit. Native-resolution paired sheets retain 840 pixels per page; selected high-risk pages were also opened individually at original resolution.
checks: Cover, contents, all eleven chapter openers, diagrams, prompt panels, code blocks, tables, appendices, references, and final changelog are legible and complete in both renderers.
No visible clipping, overlapping text, missing glyphs, misplaced artwork, or broken table rows were found.
The three-line shell panel moves intact from page 41 to page 42 with its final padding. No empty continuation strip remains.
Page 54 running header reads APPENDIX C: PACKAGE MAP. Page 55 reads FURTHER READING. Chapter continuation headers and opener suppression remain correct.
Page 56 contains the complete changelog on a single final page, with previous edition identity, prior Daytime SHA-256, four grouped changes, and source links.
paginationObservation: Page 52 is a short two-line continuation of the capstone answer key. It remains readable and is accepted without a content or layout change.
limitations: Visual approval binds only these exact Daytime PDF bytes. Paired appearance parity, Markdown/reader validation, public package assembly, and release/deployment acceptance have separate evidence and owners.
